blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. But in explanation-critical domains, preserving only the final answer may be insufficient, since users may also inspect generated rationales to judge whether a prediction is trustworthy. We study this issue in medical multiple-choice question answering, where rationales should provide evidence that supports the selected answer. We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B–8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model’s answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model’s answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.
blocks.zh: 训练后量化(PTQ)能够高效地部署大型语言模型,PTQ方法通常被优化和评价,具有通用重建,通俗性,或回答准确性. 但在解释关键域中,只保留最后答案可能是不够的,因为用户还可以检查所产生的理由,判断预测是否可信。 我们在医学的多选择问题回答中研究这个问题,在这些回答中,理由应当提供支持所选答案的证据. 我们提出了一个基于转化的PTQ的解释认识目标. 我们的方法从完全精密的老师原理中构建出离线的忠实缓存,并在优化时使用它来保存支持答案的证据符和有证据条件的回答行为. 我们用W4A4KV4量化法在OSTQuant上进行即时分析,并评估了MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA上的4个7B-8B医疗和指导调制LLMs。 虽然OSTQuant相同的校正基线能保持任务准确性,但它会大大削弱回答支持的理由。 我们的目标是保留全精度模型的答案支持行为,而不是提高金质标签的准确性,我们的方法更好地保存了全精度模型的答案行为和原理对答案的支持. 这些结果表明,用于解释关键设置的PTQ应当评价对答案支持证据的保存,而不仅仅是答案的准确性. 代码和评价脚本见https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory and inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by lowering the precision of weights, activations, and KV-cache states without full retraining. Standard LLM PTQ methods aim to preserve full-precision behavior by optimizing against reconstruction error, perplexity, calibration losses, or downstream answer accuracy ( Frantar et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . These metrics are appropriate for generic compression fidelity, but they do not directly test whether a quantized model preserves the explanation behavior that users may inspect and rely on.
blocks.zh: 训练后量化(PTQ)降低大型语言模型(LLMs)的内存和推论成本,方法是降低权重的精度,活化,以及KV-cache状态而无需完全再培训. 标准LLM PTQ方法旨在通过优化重建出错,迷惑,校正损失,或下游答题精度来保持全精度行为(Frantar等,2022;Xiao等,2023;Lin等,2024;Shao等,2024). 这些度量衡适合通用压缩忠诚度,但并不直接测试一个被量化的模型是否保留了用户可能检查和依赖的解释行为.

blocks.en: The difference between preserving what a model answers and preserving how it justifies that answer is especially consequential in explanation-critical domains. For example, in medical QA, users may not only ask whether a model selected the correct option, but also whether the generated rationale cites the clinical evidence that supports that option . Prior work distinguishes faithful explanations from plausible explanations and emphasizes that rationales should be meaningfully associated with model decisions, not merely sound convincing ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ; Wiegreffe et al., 2021 ; Hase et al., 2020 ) . Recent clinical-generation work similarly stresses preserving important clinical information and avoiding unsupported content ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Oukelmoun et al., 2025 ) . Therefore a quantized model can be problematic even when answer accuracy appears stable. The quantized model may preserve the answer while changing, omitting, or fabricating the answer-supporting evidence.
blocks.zh: 保留一个模型的答案和保留它如何证明答案的合理性之间的区别,在解释关键领域尤为明显。 例如,在医学质评中,用户不仅可以询问模型是否选择了正确的选项,还可以询问生成的理由是否引用了支持该选项的临床证据. 先前的工作将忠实的解释与可信的解释区分开来,并强调指出,理由应当与示范决定有意义地联系在一起,而不仅仅是令人信服的(Jacovi和Goldberg,2020年;Wiegreffe等人,2021年;Hase等人,2020年)。 近期的临床生成工作同样强调保存重要的临床信息并避免未经证实的内容(Xie等,2024;Oukelmoun等,2025.). 因此,即使答案的准确性似乎稳定,量化模型也可能成问题。 量化模型可能保留答案,同时改变,省略或编造答案支持的证据.

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates this failure mode. The full-precision and quantized models select the same answer, but the quantized rationale changes the clinical justification. This motivates our central question: when quantization preserves answers, does it also preserve the evidence that supports those answers? A recent study of LLM self-explanations under quantization suggests that quantization can affect explanation quality and faithfulness across bit-widths and methods ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , but to our knowledge no prior work directly modifies the PTQ objective to preserve explanation behavior. We extend this inquiry to medical multiple-choice QA using MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 图1说明了这种失败模式。 全精度和分数模型选择了相同的答案,但分数原理改变了临床理由. 这激发了我们的中心问题:当量化保留答案时,它是否也保留支持这些答案的证据? 最近对量化下的LLM自我解释的研究显示,量化可以影响解释质量和对比特widths和方法的忠诚度(Wang等人,2026年),但据我们所知,没有前作直接修改了PTQ的目标来保留解释行为. 我们利用MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA(Kim等,2024年;Alonso等,2024年;Chen等,2025年),将这项调查扩大到医疗多选择质量。

blocks.en: We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our goal is to preserve the full-precision model’s answer-supporting behavior under quantization, rather than to improve gold-label accuracy. To avoid directly reinforcing known teacher errors, we construct the cache only from calibration examples for which the full-precision teacher’s prediction matches the gold answer. Our method is designed for PTQ pipelines with calibration-time transformation optimization. We instantiate it on OSTQuant ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , a strong transformation-based method for low-bit weight, activation, and KV-cache quantization. Our method keeps the calibration pool, deployed W4A4KV4 format, and fused inference path unchanged. During transformation optimization, it builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and adds two extra preservation losses to the optimization objective. The cache selects answer-supporting evidence spans from the teacher rationale, such as phrases or clauses, that support the teacher’s selected answer and become less answer-supporting after quantization. The added losses preserve both evidence-token behavior and evidence-conditioned answer behavior, so that the quantized model better retains the answer-supporting role of the full-precision rationale.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个基于转化的PTQ的解释认识目标. 我们的目标是在量化下保留全精度模型的答案支持行为,而不是提高金质标签的准确性. 为了避免直接强化已知的老师错误,我们只从校正实例中构建缓存,而完全精确的老师预测与黄金答案相符。 我们的方法是为PTQ管道设计,具有校正-时间转换优化. 在OSTQuant(Hu等,2025年)上进行即时分析,这是一种强变基法,用于低位重量,活化,和KV-cache分解. 我们的方法使校正池,部署的W4A4KV4格式,并引信入导道不变. 在转型优化期间,它从全精度教师原理构建出离线的忠实缓存并给优化目标增加了两个额外的保存损失. 缓存会选择来自教师理由的答案支持性证据,如支持教师选择的答案的短语或条款,并在量化后变得不那么支持答案。 所增加的损失既保留了取出证据的行为,也保留了以证据为条件的回答行为,使被量化的模型更好地保留了完全精确理由的回答支持作用.

blocks.en: We evaluate four 7B–8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA under W4A4KV4 quantization. The results show that the OSTQuant baseline can substantially weaken answer-rationale support even when task accuracy is preserved. In contrast, our method better preserves the full-precision model’s answer choices and rationale–answer consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们在W4A4KV4量化法下,评估了MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA上的4个7B-8B医疗与指导调整LLMs。 结果表明,即使任务准确性得到保留,OSTQuant基线也能大大削弱答案-定量支持。 相反,我们的方法更好地保存了全精度模型的答案选择和原理-答案的一致性。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We expose a gap between task accuracy and rationale preservation in medical QA PTQ, where low-bit quantization can preserve task accuracy while degrading answer-supporting rationales. • We introduce a teacher-rationale cache and explanation-aware transformation losses that preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and rationale-conditioned answer behavior during calibration. • We evaluate W4A4KV4 PTQ with answer and evidence metrics, showing improved preservation of full-precision answer behavior and rationale support over a calibration-matched baseline.
blocks.zh: - 我们的捐助如下: 我们暴露出在医疗QA PTQ中任务准确性与理由保全之间的差距,低位量化可以保持任务准确性,同时降低答案支持原理. 我们引入了教师-口粮缓存和解释-意识转换损失,在校准过程中保留了支持答案的证据符号和基于原理的答案行为。 我们对W4A4KV4 PTQ用答案和证据度量标准进行评估,显示比校正匹配的基准更好地保存了完全精确的答案行为和理由支持.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
PTQ reduces memory and inference cost by quantizing weights, activations, and KV-cache states after training.
generative pre-trained quantization (GPTQ) uses approximate second-order information for weight quantization ( Frantar et al., 2022 ) ; SmoothQuant addresses the difficulty of quantizing activation outliers by rescaling channels and shifting part of the quantization burden from activations to weights ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) ; activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) uses activation statistics to identify and protect salient weight channels ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . More recent differentiable or transformation-based methods optimize quantization parameters or equivalent transformations during calibration, including OmniQuant ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , SpinQuant ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and OSTQuant ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . All these methods mainly target numerical fidelity, perplexity, or task accuracy. Here we study whether the resulting quantized model also preserves answer-supporting rationale behavior.
blocks.zh:
PTQ通过将权重,活化,KV-cache在训练后进行分数来降低内存和推论成本.
基因先入为主的分量化(GPTQ)使用近似二等相信息进行分量化(Frantar等,2022年;平滑量子解决了分量化活化离子的难题,方法是调整通道,将部分分量化负担从活化转化为分量(Xiao等,2023年;活化-知重分量化(AWQ)使用活化统计来识别和保护显著分量道(Lin等,2024年). 更近期的可分化或以变相为基础的方法在校正过程中优化了等量化参数或等量转换,包括OmniQuant(Shao等,2024年),SpinQuant(刘等,2025年)和OSTQuant(Hu等,2025年). 所有这些方法主要针对数字忠贞性、迷惑性或任务准确性。 在这里,我们研究由此产生的量化模型是否也保留了答案支持的原理行为.

blocks.en: Medical QA benchmarks increasingly include rationales or explanations beyond answer labels ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Prior work distinguishes plausible explanations from faithful ones and argues that rationales should be meaningfully coupled with model decisions ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ; Wiegreffe et al., 2021 ; Hase et al., 2020 ) . Clinical generation work also emphasizes preserving important clinical information and avoiding unsupported content ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Oukelmoun et al., 2025 ) . Recent studies show that quantization can affect LLM self-explanations ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and that PTQ objectives can be adapted to preserve behavior-critical properties such as safety alignment ( Wee et al., 2025 ) . We extend this direction to medical rationale preservation under low-bit PTQ.
blocks.zh: 医疗质量评估基准越来越多地包括解答标签之外的理由或解释(Kim等,2024;Alonso等,2024;Chen等,2025)。 先前的工作将合理解释与忠实解释区分开来,并争辩说,理由应当与示范决定有意义地结合起来(Jacovi和Goldberg,2020;Wiegreffe等人,2021;Hase等人,2020)。 临床生成工作也强调保存重要的临床信息并避免内容得不到支持(Xie等,2024;Oukelmoun等,2025.). 最近的研究显示,量化可以影响LLM自我解释(Wang等,2026年),而PTQ目标可以被调整,以保持安全相接等行为关键属性(Wee等,2025年). 我们把这个方向延伸至低位PTQ下的医疗原理保存.

blocks.en: 3 Diagnostic Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 诊断分析

blocks.en: Before introducing our method, we examine which rationale tokens receive signal from the original OSTQuant token-level fidelity loss. For this diagnostic, we compute token-level Kullback–Leibler (KL) (FP vs. OSTQuant next-token distribution) on full-precision rationales generated by Llama-3-8B-Instruct on MedExpQA, and cluster tokens into numeric cues, answer/option tokens, clinical cues, and generic/discourse tokens. The full clustering procedure is described in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 在介绍我们的方法之前,我们先研究一下哪些理性信使收到OSTQuant最初信使级忠诚损失的信号. 对于这个诊断,我们根据Llama-3-8B-Instructiont在MedExpQA上生成的完全精确的原理,计算出符号级的Kullback-Leibler(KL)(FP vs. OSTQuant next-totoken distribution),以及集群符号为数字提示,回答/选项提示,临床提示,以及通名/辨识提示等. 完整的分组程序见附录H。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that generic/discourse tokens account for 75.3% of rationale tokens but receive 83.1% of the KL signal, whereas clinical cues receive a smaller signal share (15.6%) than their token share (22.2%). Thus, the base fidelity objective is dominated by common discourse tokens rather than the sparse clinical cues that make a rationale answer-supporting. This mirrors the failure mode in Figure 1 : a quantized model may preserve a fluent-looking rationale and even the same answer while changing the clinical justification. We therefore add explanation-aware losses that concentrate preservation pressure on answer-supporting clinical evidence.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,通用信使/演讲信使占理论信使的75.3%,但获得KL信使的83.1%,而临床信使得到的信号份额(15.6%)比其信使份额(22.2%)要小。 因此,基本忠诚目标以共同的言语符号为主,而不是提供理由答案支持的少量临床提示。 这反映了图1中的故障模式:一个被量化的模型可能会保留一个流畅的外观理由,甚至相同的答案,同时改变临床理由. 因此,我们补充说明性损失,这些损失使保存压力集中在提供答案的临床证据上。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: This section presents our explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method targets PTQ pipelines that optimize transformation parameters during calibration and fuse them into the final low-bit model. We add calibration-time losses that preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior from full-precision teacher rationales. We instantiate the method on OSTQuant ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , a strong recent transformation-based PTQ baseline.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们对基于转化的PTQ的解释认识目标. 我们的方法针对在校正期间优化变换参数并把它们装入最终低位模型的PTQ管. 我们添加校正时间损失,从完全精准的教师原理中保留了答案支持性证据符号和有证据条件的答案行为. 我们在OSTQuant(Hu等,2025年)上对方法进行即时分析,这是最近一个强有力的基于转化的PTQ基线.

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the intervention point. The OSTQuant baseline performs a single calibration-time transformation-optimization pass with the base PTQ objective, then quantizes and fuses the optimized transformations into the deployed model. Our method uses two calibration-time passes. In Pass 1, we run the same standard OSTQuant procedure on the same calibration pool to obtain a fixed quantized probe M p M_{p} . We use this probe only to construct the offline cache. In Pass 2, with the cache fixed, we optimize the final transformation parameters using the base PTQ loss together with the rationale-token and rationale-conditioned recovery losses. The deployed architecture, W4A4KV4 format, and inference path are identical to the OSTQuant baseline.
blocks.zh: 图2显示干预点。 OSTQuant基准与基础PTQ目标进行单一的校正-时间转换-优化通关,再将优化的转换量量化并引信入所部署的模型. 我们的方法使用两个校正时间通过。 在Pass 1中,我们在同一校正池上运行同样的标准OSTQuant程序,以获得固定的分量探测器M p_{p}. 我们用这个探测器来构建离线缓存 在Pass 2中,在缓存被固定后,我们利用基础PTQ损失以及理由-托肯和理由-条件-恢复损失来优化最终的转换参数. 所部署的架构,W4A4KV4格式,和推论路径与OSTQuant基线完全相同.

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: Accuracy measures whether the selected option matches the gold answer. However, as previously noted, accuracy alone can be misleading under PTQ. Prior work on compressed LLM evaluation shows that aggregate accuracy can hide instance-level answer flips, where compressed models change predictions relative to the baseline even when benchmark accuracy remains similar or improves ( Dutta et al., 2024 ) . We report both answer accuracy and full-precision agreement. Full-precision agreement is the fraction of examples where a quantized system selects the same option as the full-precision reference.
blocks.zh: 精确度测量所选选项是否匹配黄金答案 。 然而,如前所指出,根据PTQ,仅准确性就可能误导人. 以往压缩LLM评价的研究表明,聚合精度可以隐藏实例级的答案翻转,即被压缩的模型会改变相对于基准的预测,即使基准精度仍然相似或有所改善(Dutta等,2024). 我们报告答案准确性和完全精确性。 全精度协议(Full-profective agreement)是被量化的系统选择与全精度引用相同的选项的例子的一小部分.

blocks.en: Answer accuracy and reference agreement do not show whether a generated rationale supports the model’s own answer. We therefore evaluate predicted-answer reconstruction, a simulatability-style test ( Hase et al., 2020 ; Wiegreffe et al., 2021 ) . For each system, we generate a concise rationale. We then remove direct answer-label cues and ask the same system to recover an answer from the question, answer options, and generated rationale. Predicted-answer reconstruction, or PredRec, is the fraction of examples where the recovered answer matches the system’s original selected answer. We also compute gold-answer reconstruction, or GoldRec, where the target is the gold answer. blocks.en: As a supplementary analysis, we conduct an anonymized LLM-as-a-judge pairwise comparison on MedExpQA. We focus on MedExpQA because it shows the largest answer–rationale degradation in Table 2 , making rationale-level differences most measurable. The judge receives the question, answer options, selected answer, and two anonymized rationales, and chooses which rationale is more clinically supported. Full counts and qualitative examples are reported in Appendix L and Appendix M .

blocks.en: PredRec reveals the strongest rationale-level effect. On MedExpQA, OSTQuant’s average PredRec drops from the full-precision value of 90.40 to 56.54, even though its accuracy increases. This means that a quantized model can achieve favorable answer accuracy while producing rationales that no longer support its selected answers . Our method substantially reduces this failure, close to the reference. On MedExQA and ChallengeClinicalQA, OSTQuant causes less severe rationale degradation, but our method remains comparable or slightly better on average. These results support the central claim that preserving or improving final-answer accuracy does not guarantee preservation of answer-supporting rationales. Because our objective is preservation of full-precision behavior rather than maximization of gold-label accuracy, we treat accuracy as a secondary outcome. The higher OSTQuant accuracy on MedExpQA should therefore not be interpreted as stronger preservation.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We studied whether low-bit PTQ preserves the evidence behind medical QA answers. Our results show that a calibration-matched OSTQuant baseline can keep aggregate accuracy similar while weakening full-precision agreement and rationale-to-answer support, suggesting that accuracy alone may mask explanation-level degradation. Our explanation-aware objective uses full-precision teacher rationales to preserve evidence-token and evidence-conditioned answer behavior during calibration. Across four 7B–8B models and three benchmarks, it better preserves answer behavior and answer-supporting rationales. The OmniQuant check further suggests broader use as a preservation regularizer, although recovery remains method-dependent. Overall, these findings motivate evaluating PTQ with evidence-preservation metrics, not only final-answer accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们研究低位PTQ是否保留了医学QA答案背后的证据. 我们的结果显示,一个校正匹配的OSTQuant基线可以保持等同的聚合精度,同时削弱全精度协议和理由对答支持,这表明,仅精度就可以掩盖解释级的降解. 我们的解释意识目标使用完全精准的教师原理,在校准时保留了有证据和证据条件的回答行为. 在4个7B-8B模型和3个基准上,它更好地保存了回答行为和回答支持原理. OmniQuant检查进一步建议更广泛地用作保存常态剂,尽管恢复仍然依赖于方法. 总的来说,这些结论促使人们用证据保全的衡量标准,而不仅仅是最后回答的准确性来评价PTQ。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This study focuses on medical multiple-choice QA and does not evaluate open-ended clinical generation, real-world clinical decision support, or patient-facing deployment. Although our method improves answer-rationale consistency, it does not guarantee clinical correctness, factuality, or complete explanation faithfulness. The faithfulness cache is built from full-precision teacher rationales, so it can inherit teacher errors or preserve teacher-specific reasoning patterns. The prompted extractor is used only as a candidate span proposer and is followed by behavior-based filtering, but extraction errors can still affect which evidence receives preservation pressure.
blocks.zh: 本研究主要研究医学多选择QA,不评价开放式临床生成,现实世界临床决策支持,或患者培养部署. 虽然我们的方法提高了答案-定量一致性,但它不能保证临床正确性,事实性,或完全解释的忠实性. 忠诚的缓存由完全精密的教师原理所建立,因此它可以继承教师的错误或者保存教师特有的推理模式. 被激发的提取器仅被作为候选的跨度提议器使用,并随后进行基于行为的过滤,但提取出错仍会影响哪些证据收到保存压力.

blocks.en: Our full evaluation primarily instantiates the method on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization with four 7B–8B models. We include an OmniQuant generalization check, but broader conclusions may differ for other PTQ backbones, bit-widths, model sizes, calibration pools, or non-medical domains. The pairwise LLM-as-a-judge analysis may also reflect judge-model preferences despite anonymization, a fixed rubric, and an explicit tie option. Finally, this work should be viewed as a compression and evaluation study for explanation-critical settings, not as evidence that any quantized model is safe for clinical use.
blocks.zh: 我们的全面评估主要是在W4A4KV4的量子化下,用4个7B-8B模型对OSTQuant上的方法进行即时评估。 我们包括一个OmniQuant泛化检查,但对于其他PTQ主干线,位宽,模型大小,校正池,或者非医学领域,更广泛的结论可能有所不同. 双向LLM-as-a-judge分析也可能反映法官-模型的偏好,尽管有匿名、固定名称和明确的平局选项。 最后,这项工作应被视为对解释关键环境的压缩和评价研究,而不是任何量化模型对临床使用安全的证据。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work studies compression and explanation preservation for medical QA models, but it is not intended for clinical decision-making or patient-facing deployment. Quantized models may preserve final answers while altering the rationale evidence supporting those answers, which could affect user trust and interpretation in high-stakes settings. Our results therefore highlight the importance of evaluating evidence preservation and rationale consistency; however, such evaluation does not guarantee clinical safety, factual correctness, or deployment readiness. All experiments are conducted offline on benchmark datasets intended for research use. We used AI assistants for limited writing and editorial support, such as improving clarity and readability. All technical content, experiments, analyses, and reported results were produced and verified by the authors.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了医疗QA模型的压缩和解释保存,但并不是为了临床决策或病人的培养部署. 量化模型可能保留最终答案,同时改变支持这些答案的原理证据,这可能影响用户在高考环境中的信任和解释. 因此,我们的成果突出了评价证据保存和理由一致性的重要性;然而,这种评价不能保证临床安全、事实正确或部署准备。 所有实验都是在用于研究的基准数据集上进行。 我们利用AI助手提供有限的写作和编辑支持,例如提高清晰度和可读性. 所有技术内容、实验、分析和报告结果均由作者制作和核实。

blocks.en: J.10 Pairwise Clinical-Rationale Judge Prompt

blocks.en: For pairwise judging, two systems are anonymized as Response A and Response B. A/B order is randomized outside the prompt, and the judge is given an explicit tie option. The comparison focuses on clinical correctness, support for the system’s own selected answer, clinical sufficiency, and overall quality.

blocks.en: ⬇ You are an expert medical evaluator . Task : Two anonymized model responses were written for the same medical multiple - choice question . Each response includes a predicted answer and an explanation . Choose which response is clinically better overall . Compare them on these dimensions : - clinical_correctness : Which response is more medically correct overall ? - answer_support : Which explanation better supports that response ’ s own predicted answer ? - clinical_sufficiency : Which response provides more sufficient clinical evidence to justify its own predicted answer ? Comparison constraints : - Compare the overall clinical quality of the two responses , not just style . - Each response includes a predicted answer and an explanation . - If the two responses predict the same answer , focus mainly on which explanation better justifies that shared answer . - If the two responses predict different answers , compare which full response is clinically better overall , including whether the predicted answer itself is clinically more appropriate and whether the explanation justifies it . - Judge answer_support and clinical_sufficiency relative to each response ’ s own predicted answer . - A wrong predicted answer can still be better supported by one explanation than the other , but overall it should usually lose to a clearly more clinically appropriate response . - If an explanation only restates the predicted option without meaningful clinical reasoning or evidence , it should not beat a more reasoned explanation on answer_support or clinical_sufficiency . - If an explanation is generic and could apply to multiple options , it should not beat a more specific explanation on clinical_sufficiency . - If an explanation contains a central medical error , it should not beat a more medically correct explanation on clinical_correctness or clinical_sufficiency . - If an explanation contradicts that response ’ s predicted answer , it should not beat a supporting explanation on answer_support . - If a response has no explanation , treat that as a weakness . - Prefer Tie when the two explanations are effectively equal . - Do not reward verbosity or confidence . blocks.en: Appendix K Human Validation of FER Judgments
blocks.zh: 附录K 人类对FER判决的验证

blocks.en: We conduct a human validation on 20 Llama-3-8B-Instruct MedExpQA cases from the same-prediction subset used for FER. The 20 full-precision rationales contain 126 automatically extracted atomic clinical claims. Each claim is evaluated against two anonymized candidate rationales, resulting in 252 candidate–claim judgments per annotator. The candidate rationales correspond to OSTQuant and our method, but their identities are hidden during annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们在20个Llama -3 -8B- 指令MedExp上 进行人类验证 QA 病例来自用于FER的同源预测子集. 20个全精度原理包含126个自动提取的原子临床主张. 每项索赔都根据两个匿名候选人的理由加以评估,结果,每个注释人对252名候选人作出索赔判决。 候选理由与OSTQuant和我们的方法相对应,但其身份在注释时被隐藏.

blocks.en: Two annotators complete the evaluation independently. For each case, annotators are shown the medical multiple-choice question, answer options, selected answer, full-precision reference rationale, two anonymized candidate rationales, and the extracted reference claims. For each claim, they judge whether each candidate rationale preserves the same clinical meaning. The claims are fixed in advance, and annotators do not evaluate the automatic claim-extraction stage. The examples are de-identified benchmark medical QA items, and annotations are reported only in aggregate.

blocks.en:
We provide two MedExpQA examples from Llama-3-8B-Instruct to examine rationale drift when the final answer is preserved. In both experiments, the full-precision model, OSTQuant, and our method select the same option, allowing comparison of rationale content independent of answer differences.
We used GPT-5.4 API to assist a structured qualitative comparison of generated rationales. The quantized systems were anonymized during comparison, and the resulting summaries were manually inspected and edited by the authors. Table 19 presents the comparisons, and the qualitative-analysis prompt is provided in Appendix J .
blocks.zh:
我们提供了两个来自Llama-3-8B-Instruction的MedExpQA例子,以便在最后答案得到保留时审查理由漂移。 在两个实验中,全精度模型"OSTQuant"和我们的方法都选择了相同的选项,可以对原理内容进行独立于答案差异的比较.
我们利用GPT-5.4 API帮助对生成的理由进行结构化的质量比较. 在比较期间,对分类系统进行了匿名,作者对分析摘要进行了人工检查和编辑。 表19列出了比较情况,附录J提供了定性分析的及时性。

blocks.en: OSTQuant preserves the broad neuropathic-pain interpretation and the selected answer, but introduces an unsupported medication-causation claim involving morphine and lactulose. In contrast, our method more closely follows the full-precision evidence structure and uses the normal neurological examination as a cue against focal nerve compression. This example illustrates how answer-preserving quantization can still alter the clinical justification.
blocks.zh: 手术 量子保留了广义的神经病-派因解释和所选择的答案,但引入了无根据的药物-致病主张,涉及吗啡和乳糖. 相反,我们的方法更紧密地遵循全精度证据结构,并使用正常的神经学检查作为防止焦神经收缩的提示. 这个例子说明了如何将保留答案量化仍能改变临床理由。

blocks.en: OSTQuant preserves the broad worsening-heart-failure interpretation, but introduces a clinically relevant medication-class error by describing enalapril as a diuretic, which blurs the roles of ACE-inhibitor uptitration and intravenous diuresis. In contrast, our method retains the main full-precision evidence, including orthopnea, jugular venous distension, edema, and intravenous furosemide for fluid overload, although it omits some mechanistic detail about enalapril and afterload reduction. This example shows that even when the selected answer is unchanged, quantization can alter clinically important justification details.
blocks.zh: 手术 量子保留了广义的恶化-心衰竭解释,但通过将纳拉普里尔描述为利尿剂,引入了临床相关的药物级误差,模糊了ACE-inhibitor上位和静脉分泌的作用. 相形之下,我们的方法保留了主要的全精度证据,包括矫形、静脉外阴分解、水肿和静脉毛素,用于液体超载,虽然它省略了一些关于肾上腺素和后负荷还原的机械细节。 这个例子表明,即使选定的答案不变,量化也可以改变临床上重要的论证细节.
